concept.hr: Periodičan signal: zbroj sinusnih titraja na višekratnicima osnovne frekvencije
concept.en: A periodic signal is a sum of sine waves at multiples of a base frequency

summary.hr: Do 30 sinusnih titraja od 1 do 30 Hz, svaki sa svojom amplitudom i fazom, zbraja se u jedan signal; isti brojevi daju njegov spektar.
summary.en: Up to 30 sine waves from 1 to 30 Hz, each with its own amplitude and phase, add up to one signal; the same numbers give its spectrum.

what.hr: Aplet fourier.html i tekst odjeljka o Fourierovoj transformaciji (50ohm.de, hrvatski prijevod)
what.en: The applet fourier.html and the text of the Fourier transform section (50ohm.de, Croatian translation)

changes.hr: Prilagođen simdeck kitu i nacrtan bez vanjskih biblioteka (SVG umjesto three.js), preveden na engleski, dodani sinusni, pilasti i trokutasti predložak te predložak s pomaknutim fazama, spektar crta amplitude
changes.en: Adapted to the simdeck kit and drawn without outside libraries (SVG instead of three.js), translated into English, sine, sawtooth, triangle and shifted-phase presets added, the spectrum draws the amplitudes
